{{Hatnote|This page documents a Players Committee constructed pool used for a published event.}}
'''Premiere to Virtual Set 3''' is a constructed environment used for the [[2025 Online Retro Event for Charity]]: printed Decipher cards plus Virtual Sets through [[Virtual Set 3]].<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-06-online-retro-event-for-charity-premiere-to-virtual-set-3/ 2025-06 Online Retro Event for Charity – Premiere to Virtual Set 3], starwarsccg.org</ref>

It differs from [[Premiere - Death Star II]], which has no current virtual cards, and from [[Open]], the full current virtual pool. It is also not [[Premiere - Original VS3]], the 2002 original Virtual Set 1–3 slips.
